SELECT CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS STDCATLG_ID, CQDT.DESCRIPTION, CQDT.MAKER_NAME, CQDT.MAKER_CODE, ( CASE WHEN STCK.MAX_STOCK_QTY - STCK.AVAIL_QTY - STCK.PRE_GR_QTY < 0 THEN 0 -- 최대재고 - 가용재고 - 입고예정재고 -> 발주량 ELSE STCK.MAX_STOCK_QTY - STCK.AVAIL_QTY - STCK.PRE_GR_QTY END) AS COM_STCK_QTY, STCK.SAFE_STOCK_QTY, CQDT.LIST_PRICE, ( SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CQDT.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, DECODE(CQDT.PROCESS_TYPE, '1', '재고', '3', 'VMI') AS INCOME_PATH, CQDT.SPECIFICATION, CQDT.UNIT_MEASURE, STCK.AVAIL_QTY, STCK.MAX_STOCK_QTY, STCK.MIN_ORDER_QTY, CQDT.CONTRACT_NO, CQDT.CONTRACT_SEQ, CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, CQDT.AGENT, CQDT.PROCESS_TYPE, ( SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CQDT.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEL, ( SELECT DECODE(STATUS, 'D', '삭제', 'S', '승인요청', '') FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CQDT.AGENT) AS AGENT_STATUS FROM ICOMCQDT CQDT, ICOMBYIT BYIT, WMSSTCK STCK, ICOMBYCA BYCA WHERE BYIT.BUYER = CQDT.BUYER AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CQDT.BUYER = STCK.WAREHOUSE_CODE AND CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = STCK.STDCATLG_ID AND BYIT.BUYER = BYCA.COM_CODE(+) AND BYIT.CATEGORY_NO = BYCA.STD_CATEG_ID(+) AND CQDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND BYIT.STATUS <> 'D' AND CQDT.BUYER = #{st_wms_code} --물류센터 코드 AND CQDT.PROCESS_TYPE IN ('1','3')
AND BYCA.CATEG_SYS_CODE LIKE '%' || #{st_categ_sys_code} || '%'
AND CQDT.AGENT = #{st_agent_code}
AND CQDT.PROCESS_TYPE = #{st_process_type}
AND CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE UPPER('%' || #{st_item_code} || '%')
AND CQDT.DESCRIPTION||CQDT.SPECIFICATION LIKE UPPER('%' || #{st_description} || '%')
AND STCK.AVAIL_QTY > 0 -- 재고유
AND STCK.AVAIL_QTY = 0 -- 재고무
--AND CQDT.CONTRACT_NO = STCK.CONTRACT_NO --AND CQDT.CONTRACT_SEQ = STCK.CONTRACT_SEQ AND CQDT.AGENT = STCK.AGENT
--[자동 보충발주 검색]버튼을 누른경우 -- 현재고 <= 안전재고 + (납기소요일 * 일평균소요량) -> 발주점 AND STCK.TOT_QTY <= (STCK.SAFE_STOCK_QTY + (BYIT.DELIVERY_LT * STCK.DAILY_AVG_PO_QTY)) AND STCK.SAFE_STOCK_QTY <> 0 AND STCK.MAX_STOCK_QTY <> 0
ORDER BY CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO

SELECT ( X.DEPTH -1 ) AS "Level", (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(STD_CATEG_ID), 0, 0, 1) FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE PID = X.STD_CATEG_ID ) AS "HaveChild", X.DEPTH, X.STD_CATEG_ID, X.CATEG_NAME, X.CATEG_TYPE, X.PID, X.CATEG_SYS_CODE FROM ICOMBYCA X WHERE X.COM_CODE=#{st_wms_code} AND X.PID IN ( SELECT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE=#{st_wms_code} AND PID IS NULL ) ORDER BY X.CATEG_SYS_CODE ASC, X.PID ASC

SELECT ( X.DEPTH -1 ) AS "Level", (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(STD_CATEG_ID), 0, 0, 1) FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE PID = X.STD_CATEG_ID ) AS "HaveChild", X.DEPTH, X.STD_CATEG_ID, X.CATEG_NAME, X.CATEG_TYPE, X.PID, X.CATEG_SYS_CODE FROM ICOMBYCA X WHERE X.COM_CODE=#{st_wms_code} AND X.PID = #{st_std_categ_id} ORDER BY X.CATEG_SYS_CODE ASC, X.PID ASC
mapper.update: INSERT INTO ICOMCART ( BUYER, USER_ID, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ, USE_FLAG, BUYER_ITEM_NO, AGENT, CART_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, REG_DATE, BYIT_COMORG_CODE, SEQ ) VALUES ( #{st_wms_code} , -- 1 BUYER #{st_user_id} , -- 2 USER_ID #{CONTRACT_NO} , -- 3 CONTRACT_NO #{CONTRACT_SEQ} , -- 4 CONTRACT_SEQ 'C', -- USE_FLAG #{BUYER_ITEM_NO} , -- 5 BUYER_ITEM_NO #{AGENT} , -- 6 AGENT #{COM_STCK_QTY} , -- 7 CART_QTY #{LIST_PRICE} , -- 8 UNIT_PRICE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), #{st_wms_code} , -- 9 BYIT_COM_ORG_CODE (SELECT DECODE(MAX(SEQ),NULL,'0', MAX(SEQ))+1 FROM ICOMCART WHERE BUYER = #{st_wms_code} AND USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND USE_FLAG = 'C' ) )
